title: Updated reasoning and search-enhanced text models
summary:
DeepSeek R1-0528 and a search-enhanced model joined the text lineup, alongside clearer tier docs and new per-user metrics.

`deepseek-reasoning` now uses DeepSeek R1-0528, with `deepseek-r1-0528` replacing its old alias. The new `elixposearch` model adds search-enhanced text generation. Neither model supports tools. The same PR also simplified streaming ad handling, removing the generic Ko-fi fallback when a forced ad cannot be generated.

The API docs now group authentication guidance around getting started, referrers, tokens, and tiers, including a warning against putting API tokens in frontend code. Tier descriptions were revised, and the Special Bee request form now links to the tier docs and asks for fewer fields.

Admin-only endpoints now manage per-user metrics separately from editable preferences. Ad redirects can record clicks without waiting on the metrics request, while authentication and queue-bypass handling were also adjusted.

highlights.title: DeepSeek reasoning updated
highlights.text: `deepseek-reasoning` now uses DeepSeek R1-0528. Its alias is now `deepseek-r1-0528`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-reasoning).

highlights.title: Search-enhanced text with ElixpoSearch
highlights.text: Try `elixposearch` for search-enhanced text generation. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elixposearch).
